docs/site/site.js

This script adds local search and comment emphasis to the standalone source reference.

Filter the local index without a server

Section titled “Filter the local index without a server”

The generated index is bundled with the offline site. Search filters it in the browser and creates links to local pages. The script changes displayed navigation or comment styling; it does not execute the C program, recalibrate thresholds or change stored benchmark results.

Download complete source
1/* [PM-Se3hW8] Search local generated data, never a remote API.2   textContent keeps arbitrary code/search phrases from becoming executable HTML. */3(() => {4  const search = document.getElementById('search');5  const results = document.getElementById('search-results');6  const entries = window.DOC_SEARCH || [];7  search.addEventListener('input', () => {8    const phrase = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();9    results.replaceChildren();10    if (!phrase) return;11    const matches = entries.filter(entry => `${entry.name} ${entry.detail}`.toLowerCase().includes(phrase));12    for (const entry of matches.slice(0, 16)) {13      const link = document.createElement('a');14      link.href = entry.url;15      link.textContent = entry.name;16      const detail = document.createElement('small');17      detail.textContent = `${entry.kind}: ${entry.detail}`;18      link.append(detail);19      results.append(link);20    }21    if (!matches.length) {22      const empty = document.createElement('p');23      empty.textContent = 'No match. Try a file, function or PM- tag.';24      results.append(empty);25    }26  });27  for (const link of document.querySelectorAll('nav > a')) {28    if (link.getAttribute('href') === location.pathname.split('/').pop()) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');29  }30  const focus = document.getElementById('toggle-focus');31  if (focus) focus.addEventListener('click', () => {32    const enabled = document.body.classList.toggle('comments-focus');33    focus.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));34    focus.textContent = enabled ? 'Normal contrast' : 'Emphasize comments';35  });36})();
